name: Tsukushi Monet
source:
1st year student.
Star Sign: Pisces
Likes: Tasty Food
Dislikes: Fish, Meat, Vegetables (especially Carrots), Fruit, Rice, Natto... etc.

A confident and cheeky first year high school student. 
Sensitive to the words of others and a little shy, but when he opens up his heart he can be very sweet.
Referred to as the "Monochrome Prince", his black and white paintings are highly praised despite still being a student.
He has a twin brother who is also majoring in painting.
A cousin of [url=/c53456]Tatewaki Rintarou[/url].
He has a pet hedgehog named Rin.
